name: @ezxomp/gsd-browser
description: GSD browser-tool surface for OMP: page fetch, Brave web search, DOM snapshot, navigation, and screenshots with GSD's honest-degradation reason codes.

braveApiKey.description: Brave Search API key. Precedence: BRAVE_API_KEY env > this setting > ~/.gsd/brave_api_key file. Env preferred: plugin settings are plaintext on disk.

searchTimeoutMs.description: Per-attempt Brave search timeout; GSD_WEBSEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS env overrides.

maxFetchBytes.description: Streamed byte cap for gsd_browser_fetch; truncation marker appended.

injectionBlocking.description: HIGH injection findings (3+ patterns) block with isError only when true; advisory always in details.injection.

allowPrivateHosts.description: Allow loopback/RFC1918/link-local hosts (dev servers on localhost:3000/5173/8080); false rejects with reason private_host_blocked.

captureDir.description: Screenshot capture directory; .gitignore gate written unconditionally before first capture.

browserProfileDir.description: Persistent browser profile dir; empty = fresh temp profile per launch (GSD --isolated equivalent).

browserExecutablePath.description: Browser binary override; discovery then falls back to GSD_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE env, then PATH scan.
